title: Hoshino Ichika — Smiling Once More〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami? You're by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Shiho said she'd be a little late.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Saki's on class duty today, she might be a little late too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright. If that's the case, shall we start preparing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, Saki heard from Otori that your class threw a party the other day to celebrate winning gold. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, sort of... All we did was bring drinks and snacks to class, but everyone was so chatty and excited.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's really nice that we made some nice memories together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're really amazing, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I am...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm the representative for my class, but I'm not sure that I would've been able to do what you did given the situation.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And she must have been so scared that everyone might end up hating her, like what happened in junior high...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You thought seriously about everyone's opinions, faced them directly and clearly expressed your own thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And then you guided your class towards a decision everyone could agree on. That's why I think you're so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To be honest, I wasn't sure I'd be able to handle it either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even after I made the decision to tell the class what I thought, I couldn't sleep...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You should've seen how shaky my knees were when I was standing in front of everyone in class that day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I was only able to muster up enough courage because you, MEIKO and everyone else supported me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Your encouragement convinced me that my classmates would really listen to me and that I could trust them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Again, you're really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? I think you would've handled this problem much more gracefully than I did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? What makes you think that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even when I was avoiding you during junior high, you never stopped trying, remember?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I mean, uh... Nothing worked out in the end...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that's because I didn't have the courage to tell you what had actually happened...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I had, you would've stood by my side and supported me no matter what. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Just like that time when I was being bullied by a group of boys.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh?
When did that happen?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Don't you remember?
We were in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Some boys were teasing me in the courtyard, but then you ran and stood in between us with your arms wide open and stared them down...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I remember now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They left in the end because Saki ran over and shouted at them to go away. I didn't really do anything special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But ever since you were little, you had these moments where you showed so much courage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait... You mean there's more?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Much more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... There was that time you let Saki use your textbook as an umbrella because it started raining all of a sudden and didn't want her to catch a cold...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... I do remember that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also remember my Mom being so mad at me for ruining it like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, but if you remember that,
maybe you remember that other time too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... What other time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... You know, that time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh... I need a hint!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... It was another time you did something completely unexpected, like using your textbook as an umbrella...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Uh, on second thought...
I'm not sure I actually want to know now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Now you're making me want to say it instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Hehe!
